newsitem.title: UK: Deutsche hires banker for Eastern Europe.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche hires banker for Eastern Europe.

text.p: Deutsche Morgan Grenfell (DMG), the investment banking arm of Deutsche Bank AG, said on Wednesday it had hired Michael Fortier from Morgan Stanley Dean Witter Discover & Co to develop its activities in eastern and central Europe.

A DMG spokesman told Reuters that Fortier, who was head of European emerging markets corporate finance at Morgan Stanley, would be a director "responsible for the origination and development of investment banking in eastern and central Europe".
Fortier, who was at Salomon Brothers for 13 years before moving to Morgan Stanley, will be based in London and will start work at DMG at the beginning of August.
